//: The incentive collector commits state/*.json to main every 20 minutes (~72
commits/day), and the desk loops add more. Every push to a connected repo
CREATES a deployment, and the Hobby cap is 100 Deployments Created per Day
-- which this account blew through on 2026-09-16.
deploymentEnabled turns off automatic deployments for main, which is the
only documented way to stop a deployment being created at all; it is
branch-scoped, with no path-scoped equivalent. dashboard/ is static HTML
that changes rarely, so it is redeployed deliberately from the Vercel
dashboard or CLI rather than on every state tick.
ignoreCommand is kept for the branches that still deploy (PR previews). It
skips the BUILD when a commit does not touch dashboard/, which saves build
minutes -- but note it does NOT avoid the deployment count: a skipped build
still creates a deployment, which is why Vercel publishes a separate
'Skipped deployments per minute' rate limit. Root-relative pathspec so it
works whatever the configured root directory is; if HEAD^ is missing on a
shallow clone the command errors non-zero and the build proceeds, which is
